## Stone Treant (CR 16)

**XP** 76,800  
 N Huge outsider (earth, elemental, native)  
 Init—1; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 120 ft.; Perception +27  
 

**Defense**

 
 **AC** 22, touch 7, flat-footed 22 (–1 Dex, +15 natural, –2 size)  
 **hp** 346 (21d10+210 plus 21)  
 **Fort** +19; **Ref** +13; **Will** +17  
 **DR** 10/slashing and adamantine; **Immune** elemental traits; **SR** 31  
 

**Offense**

 
 **Speed** 30 ft., burrow 5 ft.  
 **Melee** 6 slams +32 (3d8+12)  
 **Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** acidic blood (5d4 acid, DC 20 Reflex half), trample (3d8+18, DC 32)  
 

**Statistics**

 
 **Str** 35, **Dex** 8, **Con** 30, **Int** 10, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 12  
 **Base Atk** +21; **CMB** +35 (+39 to bull rush and sunder); **CMD** 44  
 **Feats** Awesome Blow, Cleave, Greater Sunder, [Powerful Maneuvers](../../rules/feats/powerful-maneuvers.md), Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (slam), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md), [Great Fortitude](../../rules/feats/great-fortitude.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Improved Bull Rush, Improved Sunder are covered by Powerful Maneuvers; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative, Great Fortitude.*  
 **Skills** Intimidate +25, Knowledge (history) +24, Knowledge (planes) +24, Perception +33, Sense Motive +27, Stealth +15 (+21 in stony underground areas); **Racial Modifiers** +6 Stealth in stony underground areas  
 **Languages** Sylvan, Terran  
 **SQ** radial symmetry  
 

**Special Abilities**

 
 **Acidic Blood (Ex)** Anyone striking the stone treant with a piercing or slashing attack and inflicting damage releases a gout of acidic blood, which causes 5d4 points of acid damage to the person who struck it. A DC 20 Reflex save reduces this damage by half. The blood becomes inert one round after leaving the elemental’s body.  
 
 **Radial Symmetry (Ex)** Because of its shape, the stone treant can bring no more than four of its slam attacks to bear on any one target. However, it also perceives the area around it equally well, and thus it cannot be flanked.  
 
 

**Ecology**

 
**Environment** underground  
 **Organization** solitary, or grove (2–16)  
 **Treasure** standard
